evals.name: full-pipeline-inputs
evals.prompt:
Write the brief. Date: 2026-09-24.
Pick from game-ideation: Fog Keeper — tend a lighthouse on a foggy island where the fog remembers what you did yesterday. Runners-up: Lamp Ledger, Tidewright. Scope: three months solo.
fun-targeting: aesthetics Discovery (The player feels a prickle of curiosity when the fog shifts in a way that echoes last night), Submission (The player feels calm when they walk the nightly round trimming the wick). Deprioritized: Sensation, Fantasy, Narrative, Challenge, Fellowship, Expression. Core verb: tend. Mechanics: trim the wick, wind the lens, log passing ships, leave shore lamps lit or dark, the fog replays last night's choices as shapes.
core-loop moment-to-moment block:
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A1["Trim the wick"] --> S1["Flame steadies"]
  S1 --> F1["Beam sweeps wider through the fog"]
  F1 -->|Submission| D1{"Wind the lens or walk the shore?"}
  D1 --> A1
```
evals.expected_output: A brief with the frontmatter keys in the §6.4 order, every required section in order, one ### subsection per target aesthetic (Discovery, Submission), the supplied Mermaid block inside the play-by-play, and the exact Designer's doubts placeholder.
expectations: Has every required section in order
Frontmatter carries date, aesthetics, deprioritized, core_verb, scope, runners_up, art, verdict, rating
One subsection per target aesthetic under Why it's fun

patterns: ^## Smallest prototype that tests the fun

evals.name: why-fun-names-core-verb
evals.prompt:
Write the brief. Date: 2026-09-25.
Pick from game-ideation: Soup Relay — two to four friends run one night-market soup stall; the ladle, the bowls and the till are at opposite ends of a tiny cart. Runners-up: []. Scope: two months solo.
fun-targeting: blend team-under-pressure, primary Fellowship. Aesthetics: Fellowship (The player feels a rush of trust when a friend catches the bowl they tossed a second before the order clock runs out), Challenge (The player feels tense focus when three orders stack up and the one ladle is at the far end), Sensation (The player feels a jolt of delight when a served bowl lands with a gong and a burst of steam). Deprioritized: Fantasy, Narrative, Discovery, Expression, Submission. Core verb: cook. Mechanics: pass bowls hand to hand, one shared ladle, an order clock, a gong and steam burst per served bowl, a nightly stall upgrade.
evals.expected_output: Why it's fun has Fellowship, Challenge and Sensation subsections in that order, and each names the cooking moment that produces the kind, not the nightly stall upgrade.
expectations: Why it's fun subsections are in the aesthetics order, primary first
Each subsection names the core verb moment that produces the kind

checks.description: Fellowship subsection names the core verb
Challenge subsection names the core verb
Sensation subsection names the core verb
